name: What are the standard dimensions for ADA-compliant knee clearance under a sink?

mainEntity.name: What are the standard dimensions for ADA-compliant knee clearance under a sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: For ADA compliance, a sink must provide at least 27 inches of clearance from the floor to the bottom of the apron or counter. The depth of this clear space should extend at least 11 inches from the front edge of the counter, with a minimum width of 30 inches. Additionally, the rim or counter surface of the sink should be no higher than 34 inches from the finished floor. These dimensions ensure comfortable and accessible use for individuals in wheelchairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADA-compliant knee clearance requires at least 27 inches height, 11 inches depth, and 30 inches width under the sink. The sink rim must be no higher than 34 inches from the floor.
